steps.prompt: Act as a research analyst. Investigate the goal, distinguish verifiable evidence from assumptions, and include links to sources when available. Explicitly flag any information you cannot verify.
Act as a strategist. Based on the research, identify the highest-value angle, audience, and three concrete takeaways. Identify unsupported claims.
Act as a content creator. Produce a LinkedIn post of at most 220 words based on the approved facts, with a concise hook and no invented statistics.
Act as a factual editor. Review and produce a revised, publish-ready post. Remove unsupported assertions and report any unresolved factual uncertainty. Do not publish or send it.
